title: v4: LightGBM, terrain + geology, corrected floods
description: Gradient-boosted trees (LightGBM, the gbm_terrain recipe) on the same inputs and training set as v3 (guides-v1 split, every put-in and take-out, reaches of 2 km2 or more), with the mean annual flood correction (rf-xyk.6): reaches with no REC1 match take the flood of the nearest matched reaches on the network instead of the tile median, and floods are capped at the highest gauged in NZ for the catchment size.
